about_the_game:
Welcome to the Gobotix, a robot manufacturing company that runs by robots.

In this distant future, humanity is long gone. The two bots - remnants of an advanced civilization - are undergoing a quality test to prove their worth. Yet with each completed challenge, they uncover fragments of forgotten messages from the past, learning not only about their makers but about what it means to exist.

About the Game


Step into a world where logic meets rhythm. Control two curious robots; each with their own charm and personality - through a series of mind-bending platform puzzles. Whether you play solo or cooperate with a friend, every level challenges your perception of space, timing, and teamwork.



Your goal is simple: solve puzzles, activate mechanisms, and reach the glowing portal that marks your success. But the path is never straightforward; buttons, lifts, portals, and physics-based contraptions will test your every move.

A Game That Plays Its Own Music




Every click, every command becomes part of the soundtrack. The game runs on an infinite looping beat, and each of your interactions adds a new musical note - creating a unique rhythm for every session. No two playthroughs ever sound the same.

Your puzzle-solving journey literally shapes the music.

What to expect


  • Two playable robots with distinct personalities
  • Designed for both single player and co-op play
  • Isometric 3D visuals with smooth, minimalist design
  • Reactive soundtrack that evolves with your actions
  • Clever physics elements for dynamic puzzle solving
  • Free to play — with optional DLC packs that simply support the developers

Support the Robots


The game is completely free. Optional DLCs offer no gameplay advantages; only a way to show support through the "pay what you want" options. Supporters might just see their robots react with a little extra warmth and surprise during their adventures.

The Journey Ahead


The game currently features 25 handcrafted levels, each designed to test precision, logic, and rhythm. New levels will be released as free content packages, expanding the robots’ story and world over time.
